newsitem.title: FRANCE: French wheat slips on forecasts of record harvest.
newsitem.headline: French wheat slips on forecasts of record harvest.

text.p: French wheat slipped further on Thursday, undermined by prospects of a record crop in France, dealers said.
Wheat into Rouen for prompt and forward delivery was down 2.5 francs at 880 francs.
French wheat growers forecast earlier in the day France may harvest 34 million tonnes of soft wheat in 1996 against 29.8 million tonnes in 1995.
According to trade sources, national grain office ONIC is targeting a crop of 33.8 million tonnes.
Dealers said the new forecasts even exceeded recent trade estimates of a crop of 33 million to 33.5 million tonnes.
